hook.name: OfficialFloorHook
hook.description: Custom bonding curve AMM hook for the FLOOP protocol: mints FLOOP tokens on ETH-in buys and burns them on FLOOP-in sells, fully handling swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Enforces an ETH-backed floor price through CurveEngine and EthTreasuryVault, with configurable buy fees and sell fees managed by FloorManager.
